artworks.title: A Rustic House in the Grand Rue at Sceaux-Les-Chartreux
artworks.medium: brown chalk and brown wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a rustic building viewed from the ground level. The building dominates the scene, with no visible horizon. The building has rough stone walls and thatched roofs depicted in fine brushstrokes. The sepia tones create a warm, earthy color palette. Close to the right, there is a seated figure, likely an elderly woman. Next to her is a barrel and a bundle of sticks or logs against the wall. The image portrays everyday simplicity and country life.

artworks.title: Grove of Trees
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray wash on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Jean and Kahlil Gibran
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape from a slightly elevated angle, showing trees and an open expanse in the distance. The loose and fluid brushstrokes create an impressionistic style with earthy tones dominating the color palette. The trees in the foreground lead the eye towards the open space hinting at land stretching beyond.

artworks.title: The Gallant Gardener
artworks.medium: red chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a scene from a slightly elevated angle. The ground and figures can be seen, with natural elements framing the top. The drawing is characterized by red chalk strokes, creating a delicate texture. The technique conveys movement and elegance. The color palette is monochromatic with warm tones. There is a tree with an anthropomorphic quality and a wheelbarrow, as well as two figures conversing. The scene is bordered by decorative foliage elements.

artworks.title: At the Square
artworks.medium: color lithograph on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a woman and a child walking together. The woman is in profile, holding a red umbrella and the child's hand. She wears a green hat, a blue and white striped blouse, and an orange skirt with a green belt. The child wears a yellow dress and a pink bonnet with red polka dots, and holds a red bucket.

artworks.title: Pluto
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut printed from three blocks: dark gray line block with middle and light gray tone blocks on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a crowned, muscular figure with a trident in a dramatic pose amidst a fiery, chaotic scene. The central figure is standing with their back to the viewer, displaying strong, defined musculature. The figure wears a crown and holds a trident in one hand. A flowing cape billows from the figure's shoulders. The scene is framed within an oval and depicts a setting engulfed in flames, with architectural structures visible in the background and a group of indistinct figures. The detailed shading and lines give depth and dynamism to the composition.

artworks.title: Subir y bajar (To Rise and To Fall)
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint with burnishing on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing with creatures and dynamic movement. It features a whimsical figure standing atop a hairy, mythological creature. The large creature is on a sloped surface. Another figure is descending on the right. The background is minimal, enhancing the figures' gestures. The characters have exaggerated features and dynamic energy, suggesting a scene filled with imagination and folklore.

artworks.title: No hay quien nos desate? (Can't Anyone Untie Us?)
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint with burnishing on laid paper
artworks.description: This print shows two people and an owl. The two people appear to be tied together at the waist, and they stand in front of a tall tree. The woman is in front, facing us, while the man has his back to us as he bends down towards the bottom left corner. The woman has short, dark hair and wears a short-sleeved white dress. Her arms are both raised up, and her head tilts back, an expression of distress on her face. The man also has short dark hair and wears a dark jacket and knee-high pants. Both people have pale skin. A rope is visible around the woman's waist and her ankles. The man seems to be gripping the rope in one hand as he bends down. Above them, a large owl sits on the tree. One of the owl's feet appears to be on the woman's face, and one of her outstretched hands reaches toward its chest. Its wings are outstretched, and it has long ears. It is the same gray color as the sky behind it. The ground below the two people is covered in thin lines indicating grass, with a group of tall plants on the right.

artworks.title: Belshazzar's Feast
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a banquet scene unfolding in an elaborately adorned hall. The scene features a large table with finely dressed figures gathered around it. They seem engaged in conversation and merriment as they partake in a feast. The table is draped with a cloth and holds various dishes and a tiered cake. A chandelier hangs overhead, with bright lights illuminating the gathering. Architectural details like a heavy drapery canopy and walls adorned with classical motifs create a sense of opulence. In the foreground, a decorative drinking vessel is placed on a tray. Behind the main scene, a darkened background suggests depth, while intricate details of the attendees’ clothing and the scene's ornamentation convey a sense of historical richness and cultural sophistication.

artworks.title: Farmstead wtih a Peasant Family Outside the Front Door, the Woman Spinning
artworks.medium: etching, with touches of drypoint, on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 13.7 x 17.5 cm (5 3/8 x 6 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image features an etching of a rustic homestead with a slightly elevated point of view. The scene includes a house, yard, a wooden structure, pigs, and people engaged in domestic work. The intricate brushstroke technique creates texture and depth in the depiction of wooden surfaces, foliage, and cobblestones. The color palette is monochromatic, emphasizing the contrast between light and shadow. In the background, there are trees and distant structures.

artworks.title: The Farrier's Shop
artworks.artist: William Pether after Joseph Wright of Derby
artworks.medium: mezzotint on heavy laid paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of a farrier's shop at night. A strong internal light source illuminates the scene, showing a cluttered shop interior through a large window. Tools and objects related to working on horses are visible. A horse is prominently featured in front of the shop, with its head turned towards the viewer. The scene features a rich tonal contrast between light and dark, emphasizing details of the horse's form and the textures of the building. The style resembles that of Joseph Wright of Derby, known for using chiaroscuro.

artworks.title: The Flight into Egypt
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 12.8 x 11.1 cm (5 1/16 x 4 3/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts two figures partially illuminated against a dark background. One figure is holding a lantern, casting light in the surrounding area. The second figure, partially veiled, is seated on a donkey beside the first figure. The surroundings are engulfed in deep shadows, with intricate cross-hatching adding texture to the scene. The background is largely featureless.

artworks.title: Nude Seated on a Bench with a Pillow (Woman Bathing Her Feet at a Brook)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a seated nude person in a hunched, forward-leaning posture. The person's head and shoulders are slightly bowed, and their facial features are finely etched but not pronounced. Their hair is short and disheveled. There are no clothes visible, and the person is seated on a textured surface. They are holding a textile or sheet with both hands. The background is dark, contrasting with the lighter tones of the body.

artworks.title: Saint Jerome in a Dark Chamber
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 15.1 x 17.6 cm (5 15/16 x 6 15/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a person's upper body seated and engrossed in reading an open book on a table. The person appears absorbed in reading, with their face partially obscured by shadow. They wear a voluminous garment and a cap or hat, with medium-length hair. The scene is set indoors with soft light coming through a large window, casting patterns across the room. A spiral staircase is visible in the background.

artworks.title: Old Man with a Beard
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 14.1 x 10.9 cm (5 9/16 x 4 5/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image is a black and white sketch of an older man, depicting his head and shoulders. He faces slightly to the right with a thoughtful expression. The man has deep-set eyes, prominent cheekbones, and a bald head with sparse hair. He has a long, thick beard blending with the fur-like texture of his cloak, which is fastened with a circular clasp. The background is dark and textured, highlighting the man's facial features and clothing.

artworks.title: Cottages by a River
artworks.medium: black chalk with touches of graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a rural scene with thatched-roof houses next to a canal. The horizon is low with houses and trees lining the water. The drawing is sketchy with loose pencil strokes. Details are more pronounced in the foreground and fade as we look towards the canal and distant boats. The color palette is monochromatic in shades of grey and black, emphasizing the tranquil and rustic nature of the scene.

artworks.title: A Young Man Playing a Psalterium
artworks.artist: Christoffel van Sichem I after Hendrik Goltzius
artworks.medium: woodcut on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to borderline): 30.8 x 21.6 cm (12 1/8 x 8 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a person's body, including the head and upper torso. The person is seated and turned slightly to the side, looking over their shoulder directly at the viewer with a neutral expression. They have distinct facial features with a broad nose and are depicted with shoulder-length, wavy hair that peeks out from under a large, elaborate hat. The hat appears to be adorned with feathers and a decorative band. The individual is dressed in a finely detailed garment featuring puffed sleeves and intricate embroidery or trimming along the neckline. Surrounding them is another person, positioned slightly behind and to the side, wearing a draped hood that frames their face. There are also several other figures in the background, some wearing similar attire with headdresses. The setting appears to be an interior or a balcony-like space with architectural elements, such as columns and a railing, visible in the background. The entire composition is rendered in a detailed, line-based style typical of woodcuts or engravings of the period.

artworks.title: The Monkeys' Barber Shop
artworks.artist: Coryn Boel after David Teniers the Younger
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 24.7 x 32 cm (9 3/4 x 12 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of monkeys engaging in human-like activities in a barbershop. The scene shows monkeys dressed in human clothing, performing tasks typically associated with a barbershop. In the foreground, two monkeys are grooming another monkey's foot at a low table. To the right, one monkey is sitting on a chair wrapped in a cloth, while another monkey attends to its face with a basin of water nearby. In the background, a shelf holds various bottles and containers. The walls feature a mirror and a bird perched on a shelf.

artworks.title: Metamorphoses of the Day: A Conventional Marriage
artworks.medium: hand-colored lithograph on wove paper

artworks.title: Metamorphoses of the Day: Regrets, or Never till the Next Time
artworks.medium: hand-colored lithograph on wove paper

artworks.title: The Ailing Cricket
artworks.medium: hand-colored lithograph on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a print of anthropomorphic bugs in a colorful scene. The scene features three standing creatures with gray, wrinkly heads similar to those of worms, who appear to be attending to another creature who sits in a blue chair on the right. This creature has a green-and-yellow face similar to that of a cricket with two tall antennae. All four creatures are dressed extravagantly, with long jackets in shades of pale blue, green, orange, and brown over shirts, vests, and trousers. Two of the worm-like creatures have tall top hats, and one has a walking stick and yellow gloves on its human-like hands. They all face the seated cricket, and one stands beside the cricket, holding one of its wrists. To the right of the cricket is a table that holds glass bottles and a folded paper or pamphlet. The print is centered on off-white paper, and there are some lines of text above and below it.

artworks.title: Vauxhall Gardens
artworks.artist: Robert Pollard and Francis Jukes after Thomas Rowlandson, published by John Raphael Smith
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of an outdoor social gathering in a garden with a grand architectural structure. The scene features numerous figures in period clothing, gathered around a central pavilion adorned with intricate patterns and surrounded by tall trees. The architecture includes a dual-level balcony where some figures are observing the gathering below. The overall atmosphere is festive, suggesting a place of leisure and social interaction. This artwork is done in the style of Thomas Rowlandson.

artworks.title: An Old Man Reading
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The artwork depicts a man seated at a desk, engrossed in reading a large open book in front of him. He has a prominent nose, full beard, curly unkempt hair, and wears a textured robe. To his right, there is a large globe on a stand. The background shows detailed etching with light and shadow.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Young Man in Uniform
artworks.medium: pastel on blue laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a young person in a slightly tilted position, looking towards the viewer. They have fair skin, delicate facial features, eyes slightly widened, and softly closed lips. The person's hair is styled in a powdered 18th-century fashion with curls and tied with a ribbon. They wear a blue coat with red and gray trim, adorned with buttons. The background is a simple, muted grayish-brown tone.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Young Man in Uniform
artworks.medium: pastel on blue laid paper
artworks.description: The person in the image is shown from the chest up. They are facing slightly to their right, looking directly at the viewer. The individual has pale skin, prominent eyes, and a slight smile. Their hair is powdered white, styled back and tied with a black ribbon. They are wearing an ornate blue coat with red and silver trim, intricate silver embellishments, and epaulettes on the shoulders. Their attire includes a high black collar and a cravat. The background is plain and neutral. There are no visible jewelry or accessories.
